description.en: Replaces the DSH desktop stats line under the composer with a configurable status bar. Ten optional fields - status, turn and step counts, cache hit rate, first-token latency, tokens per second, session duration, last-turn cost, session cost, account balance and token totals - can be shown, hidden and reordered. Costs are estimated per call from official peak/off-peak rates, and per-model prices plus the account balance are maintained in the settings page.
description.zh: 把 DSH 桌面端输入框下方的统计行换成可配置状态栏。状态、轮次与步数、缓存命中率、首字延迟、生成速度、会话时长、本轮费用、本次会话费用、账户余额、Token 合计共 10 个字段可显示、隐藏与排序。费用按每次调用各自的时间戳与官方峰谷单价估算，模型单价与账户余额在设置页维护。
